why: The step samples input twice for one tick. The replay recorder decorates `sample()`, so every step appends two ticks to the trace for one simulated tick, and a replay of it -- the file #254's Download Replay saves -- diverges from the run it recorded. A latched one-shot press (fire, mine) is also consumed by the discarded sample.
